feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Trump says his D.C. arch will serve as 'military complex' with snipers and drones
entry.summary: President Trump has claimed that military operations are needed at his proposed triumphal arch in Washington D.C., in order to protect national security. A federal court is weighing the arch's legality.

entry.title: PHOTOS: The precarious life of fisherfolk
entry.summary: In the bustling heart of the southern Indian city of Chennai is a market that never sleeps, where residents from the poorest neighborhoods wage a battle of survival with the sea.

entry.title: A new cookbook pays tribute to two New Orleans staples — 'Rhythm & Roux'
entry.summary: At Bayou Bar, music and food go hand in hand. Which is why a new cookbook from chef Brian Landry and bandleader Peter Harris has recipes from the menu and stories from the musicians who play there.

entry.title: Judge orders Fox to hand over hundreds of documents in shareholders' case
entry.summary: Fox Corp. must turn over hundreds of documents that could shed light on how founder Rupert Murdoch handled some of his media companies' biggest scandals.

entry.title: U.S. childcare costs are astronomical. More families are turning to grandparents
entry.summary: Grandparents taking care of their grandkids is nothing new. But the surging cost of childcare in the U.S. has made familial support even more critical for some parents who struggle to afford it.

entry.title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia, including hundreds launched at Moscow
entry.summary: Moscow's mayor described the wave of drones as the "largest ever" attack on the Russian capital and said there had been damage to a Moscow oil refinery and a residential building.

entry.title: How the NPR College Podcast Challenge changed lives
entry.summary: Tee up those entries: It's time for the next NPR College Podcast Challenge, and hear how the contest changed the lives of past participants.

entry.title: NPR's College Podcast Challenge is back for 2026
entry.summary: Students: It's time to turn on the mic and hit 'record.' Send us your podcasts and we'll pick the best ones. It's $5,000 for our grand prize and $500 for our finalists.

entry.title: Thousands of planned launches, terms of deal, worry some near Louisiana SpaceX site
entry.summary: State officials say the new SpaceX site will be a $100 billion investment and launch thousands of rockets. Lawmakers helped ease regulations and negotiations were covered under nondisclosure agreements.

entry.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthis tried to attack its capital
entry.summary: Saudi Arabia said Yemen's Houthi rebels tried to attack Riyadh with a ballistic missile, the first time its capital has been targeted since the escalation in fighting with the Iran-backed rebels.
